_meta.name: gas-deploy-review-queue
_meta.description: Create Google Apps Script project, inject source via Monaco/CodeMirror API, deploy as Web App, capture exec URL for Mike Review Queue append endpoint.
anomalies: GAS editor uses Monaco (not CodeMirror) — js /*cdp*/ action with atob(b64_code) + monaco.editor.getModels()[0].setValue(code) works reliably
New Deployment dialog shows 'Loading deployment...' for 3-5s before settling to type selector (wait at least 4s after clicking 'New deployment')
Account confirmation ('You're currently signed in as mw@mike-wolf.com') appears intermittently — use mouse_click on [role='dialog'] button:last-of-type to dismiss; waits for New Deployment dialog
Type selector gear button: aria-label='Enable deployment types', gear click OPENS the type list (checkboxes appear). Do NOT click gear again — clicking twice CLOSES the list.

Web app checkbox: [role='menuitemcheckbox'][aria-label='Web app'] at approx (737, 315) — uses jsshadow/jsaction (jsaction='click:o6ZaF(preventDefault=true)'). CONFIRMED BLOCKER: mouse_click, element.click(), key Space, ax_action all fail to toggle aria-checked. jsaction_trigger action needed (see site-context.md).

Deploy button in dialog: [role='dialog'] button with text 'Deploy' — responds to element.click() but only proceeds if a type is selected. If 'Please select a deployment type' is shown, Deploy click is a no-op.
Project URL is deterministic: https://script.google.com/home/projects/1QOSgTv0gn8xiEnhEtwauAXFy4_mfe65r6_D3vlHIKMwkI54ndHSjy8TZ/edit — re-running payload opens same project
_meta.prerequisite: Chrome session logged in as mw@mike-wolf.com with Google Workspace access
blockers: Web app checkbox type selection blocked by jsshadow/jsaction — needs jsaction_trigger action type in Yeshie

chain._: PHASE 1 — Navigate to Apps Script Home

chain.note: Apps Script dashboard. Should show 'My Projects' list.
settle (was delay 3000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Confirm logged in. Look for 'My Projects' heading and '+ New project' or 'New project' button.
Click '+ New project' button. Creates blank project, redirects to editor with 'Untitled project'.
settle (was delay 5000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Confirm editor loaded. Look for: Monaco editor area, Code.gs tab, starter function myFunction(){}.

chain.code: return {url: window.location.href, hasMonaco: typeof monaco !== 'undefined', hasCM: !!document.querySelector('.CodeMirror'), title: document.title};
chain.note: Verify editor environment. We need hasMonaco=true or hasCM=true to proceed with content injection.

chain.code: const b64 = ''; const code = atob(b64); let r = {error: 'no editor found'}; try { if (typeof monaco !== 'undefined') { const models = monaco.editor.getModels(); if (models && models.length > 0) { models[0].setValue(code); r = {method: 'monaco', ok: true, models: models.length, codeLen: code.length}; } } } catch(e) { r.monacoErr = e.message; } if (!r.ok) { try { const cmEl = document.querySelector('.CodeMirror'); if (cmEl && cmEl.CodeMirror) { cmEl.CodeMirror.setValue(code); r = {method: 'codemirror', ok: true, codeLen: code.length}; } } catch(e2) { r.cmErr = e2.message; } } return r;
chain.note: Inject Apps Script source via Monaco API (base64 decode → setValue). Falls back to CodeMirror. Returns {method, ok, codeLen} on success.
settle (was delay 1000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Verify code is visible in editor. Should see 'const DOC_ID' line near top.
Click project title at top of editor to enter inline rename mode. The title text input should become active.
settle (was delay 700ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout

chain.code: const inp = document.querySelector('input[aria-label*="project"], input[placeholder*="project"], input[value="Untitled project"], .script-title-name input, [class*="title"] input'); if (inp) { inp.select(); } return {found: !!inp, tag: inp ? inp.tagName : null};
chain.note: Select-all in the rename input so our type action replaces the text cleanly.
Type new project name. abstractTarget 'gas-project-title' resolves to the active title input.
settle (was delay 300ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout

chain.code: const inp = document.querySelector('input[aria-label*="project"], input[placeholder*="project"], .script-title-name input, [class*="title"] input'); if (inp) { inp.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', bubbles: true})); inp.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', {key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', bubbles: true})); } return {pressedEnter: !!inp};
chain.note: Press Enter to confirm rename.
settle (was delay 1500ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout

chain.code: document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 's', code: 'KeyS', metaKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true})); return {triggered: true};
chain.note: Trigger Cmd+S to force save. GAS editor listens for this on the document. Auto-save may have already fired.
settle (was delay 2000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Verify project is now titled 'Mike Review Queue' and shows as saved (no unsaved indicator).
Click the 'Deploy' button in the top-right toolbar. Should open a dropdown menu.
settle (was delay 1000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Dropdown should show: 'New deployment', 'Manage deployments'. Note exact text for click_text.
Open the new deployment configuration dialog.
settle (was delay 2000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Deployment dialog should show: gear icon + 'Select type', description field, Execute as dropdown, Who has access dropdown.
Click the gear/settings icon next to 'Select type' to open deployment type selector.
settle (was delay 700ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Type selection menu. Should show options: 'Web app', 'API executable', 'Add-on', 'Library'.
Select 'Web app' as deployment type.
settle (was delay 1000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Verify Web app form loaded. Should show: Description field, Execute as (dropdown), Who has access (dropdown).
Fill the deployment description field.
wait for gas-execute-as-dropdown before next step (was delay 300ms)
Open 'Execute as' dropdown. Need to select 'Me (mw@mike-wolf.com)'.
settle (was delay 700ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Select 'Me (mw@mike-wolf.com)' from Execute as dropdown. Text may be just 'Me' or include email.
wait for gas-access-dropdown before next step (was delay 500ms)
Open 'Who has access' dropdown.
settle (was delay 700ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Check available access options. Should include 'Anyone', 'Only myself', 'Anyone with Google account'.
Select 'Anyone' (no Google account required). This is what allows unauthenticated POST requests protected by our secret.
settle (was delay 500ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Confirm form state before clicking Deploy: type=Web app, description set, Execute as=Me, Access=Anyone.
Click the final 'Deploy' button to submit the deployment. May trigger OAuth authorization flow.
settle (was delay 4000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Critical: determine state. (A) 'Deployment complete' / URL shown → success. (B) 'Authorization required' / 'Review permissions' button → need auth flow. (C) Error message → log and fail.

chain.code: const url_match = document.body.innerText.match(/https:\/\/script\.google\.com\/macros\/s\/[^\s"'<>]+\/exec/); const has_auth_req = document.body.innerText.includes('Authorization required') || document.body.innerText.includes('Review permissions') || document.body.innerText.includes('Authorize access'); const has_url = !!url_match; return {has_url, has_auth_req, url: has_url ? url_match[0] : null, page_text_snippet: document.body.innerText.slice(0, 500)};
chain.note: Quick scan: do we have the deployment URL already, or do we need to authorize?
If authorization required: click 'Authorize access' or 'Review permissions' button. Opens OAuth consent popup. Step will silently fail if not needed (deployment already succeeded).
settle (was delay 2000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Check current state. If popup opened and Chrome focused it, we may now be on accounts.google.com consent page.

chain.code: return {url: window.location.href, isAccounts: window.location.host.includes('accounts.google.com'), hasAllowBtn: !!document.querySelector('#submit_approve_access, [data-value="Allow"], button[jsname*="allow"]'), bodySnippet: document.body.innerText.slice(0, 300)};
chain.note: Detect if we're in the OAuth consent popup (accounts.google.com). If so, look for Allow button.
Click 'Allow' on the Google OAuth consent page (if we're there). Grants DocumentApp scope to the script.
settle (was delay 4000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Check state post-authorization. Should now show deployment success dialog with Web app URL.

chain.code: const url_match = document.body.innerText.match(/https:\/\/script\.google\.com\/macros\/s\/[^\s"'<>]+\/exec/); const inp = document.querySelector('input[value*="macros/s"]'); const link = document.querySelector('a[href*="macros/s"]'); return {url_from_text: url_match ? url_match[0] : null, url_from_input: inp ? inp.value : null, url_from_link: link ? link.href : null, full_body: document.body.innerText.slice(0, 1000)};
chain.note: Capture the Web app URL via multiple methods. At least one should return the exec URL.
Read URL from dialog UI elements. Backup for js step s110.
Final snapshot of deployment success dialog. Should clearly show the Web app URL. Note exact URL for storage in secrets.yaml.
